name: Maliadi

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

spells.name: Produce Flame
spells.text:
A small ball of flame appears in the palm of your hand, and you lash out with it either in melee or at range. Make a spell attack roll against your target's AC. This is normally a ranged attack, but you can also make a melee attack against a creature in your unarmed reach.

On a success, you deal 2d4 fire damage. On a critical success, the target takes double damage and @item.leveld4 persistent,fire damage.

---

Heightened (+1) Increase the damage by 1d4 and the persistent damage on a critical hit by 1d4.

items.name: Deep Breath
items.text: The maliadi can hold its breath for 1 day.

items.name: Collar of Fire
items.text:
The maliadi has resistance 20 to physical ranged attacks, such as arrows, bolts, javelins, and thrown rocks, as such attacks are magically diverted through its collar of fire.

Nonmagical weapons and ammunition affected by this ability are incinerated and destroyed.

items.name: Counterspelling Wall
items.text:
Trigger A creature within 100 feet of the maliadi that the maliadi can see Casts a Spell that targets the maliadi

---

Effect The maliadi casts one of its innate Wall of Fire spells, with a duration of 1 round.

If the spell that triggered this reaction passes through the wall of fire, the wall attempts to counteract it, with a counteract modifier of +28.

items.name: Capsize
items.text:
The maliadi tries to capsize an adjacent aquatic vessel of its size or smaller.

The maliadi must succeed at a DC 35 Athletics check check (reduced by 5 for each size smaller the vessel is than the maliadi) or the pilot's Sailing Lore DC, whichever is higher.

items.name: Change Shape
items.text:
The maliadi can take on the appearance of any Large, Huge, or Gargantuan animal. This doesn't change its Speed or Strikes.

---

items.name: River Form
items.text: The maliadi takes on the form of a stretch of river, with the effects of Migration, except the maliadi can only affect itself, appears as a section of a flowing river that takes up the same space as the maliadi, and can't leave the ground.

items.name: Trample
items.text:
Huge or smaller, foot, DC 38 Reflex save

---

text: A maliadi resembles a massive hippopotamus surrounded by a collar of flame. Maliadis are arrogant and tyrannical, and demand tribute from everyone they encounter-whether lone travelers or entire villages-to avert destruction. Many pay them off, for maliadis can hurl parts of their flaming collars to form geysers of flame or fiery walls, and they're also powerful shapeshifters.
